Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição (Sem descontos!)

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO


  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web utilizando ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Implementar e otimizar soluções utilizando HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, e JSon, garantindo alta performance e usabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo a criação e otimização de triggers, stored procedures e aplicação de regras de normalização.
  • Integrar e consumir WebServices (SOAP e REST) nas aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Controlar as mudanças no desenvolvimento de software para assegurar a estabilidade e evolução contínua dos projetos.
  • Identificar e corrigir problemas no código, bem como propor melhorias e oportunidades de refatoração para manter a qualidade do software.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócios e qualidade.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade e maturidade de software.
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Linguagem de programação: domínio de aplicação e entendimento de sintaxe e desempenho de linguagens como ASP.NET c#, Java script, Json, Bootstrap
  • Experiência com WEB JS/Jquery/Ajax, Webforms, Bootstrap, HTML, JSon e CSS, SQL Server, incluindo normalização, triggers, e stored procedures.
  • Conhecimento em SOAP e REST.
  • Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are seeking a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer.

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales performance, brand positioning, and overall growth. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, can manage a high volume of projects, and enjoy taking creative ownership, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and online marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion objectives

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print specifications

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Conduct quality control checks before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Graphic Design and/or Video Editing

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, but portfolio quality and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging work environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Requirements

Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

In addition, please include your expected monthly compensation for the services to be provided.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno (Foco em Visão Computacional e NLP)
description:
Contratação PJ

Atuação remota


Buscamos um profissional com perfil analítico e \"mão na massa\" para integrar nosso time de Analytics. O desafio não é apenas criar modelos, mas traduzir dados complexos (estruturados e não-estruturados) em insights estratégicos que direcionem as decisões do negócio.

Se você domina o ecossistema de Machine Learning e tem experiência real com processamento de imagem e texto, essa vaga é para você.


O que você fará:

  • Desenvolver modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning focados em problemas de negócio.
  • Implementar soluções de Visão Computacional e NLP (projetos reais).
  • Criar e sustentar scripts em Python utilizando frameworks como Flask ou FastAPI .
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance de modelos já em produção no ambiente GCP .
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia e TI para garantir a qualidade dos dados e das entregas.


Requisitos Essenciais (Must-have):

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Visão Computacional e NLP .
  • Domínio de Python para análise e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL .
  • Familiaridade com ambiente GCP (Google Cloud) .
  • Experiência com frameworks de API (Flask ou FastAPI ).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas eficazes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em MLOps e esteiras de monitoramento.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria ou áreas de negócio.

title: Senior Technical Sales Specialist II – NGS | Life Sciences
description:
About BGI

BGI Group was founded in 1999 in China with the vision of using genomics for the benefit of mankind and has since become the largest genomics organization in the world. With over 10,000 employees, BGI operates in more than 100 countries, focusing on research and applications in healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields. BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 3,800 publications, with 430+ publications in top-tier journals such as Nature, Science and Cell. Additionally, in the field of R&D, BGI was ranked No.1 among corporations in the life science/biotechnology sector in the Asia-Pacific region and No.5 worldwide by Nature Index.


About MGI

MGI is one of the subsidiaries of BGI Group, it is committed to building core tools and technology to lead life science through intelligent innovation. With a focus on R&D, production, and sales of DNA sequencing instruments, reagents, and related products, MGI provides real-time, panoramic, and full-life-cycle equipment and systems for precision medicine, precision agriculture, precision healthcare, and other relevant industries.


MGI is a leading producer and one of the few companies in the world that can independently develop and mass-produce clinical high-throughput gene sequencers, its multi-omics platforms include genetic sequencing, medical imaging, and laboratory automation.


Our Mission is to develop and promote advanced life science tools for future healthcare, and to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to make bold decisions that can help us achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our Message to the world is simple: lead in life science innovation, make everyone’s life healthier and longer.


Why this role matters

This role is for professionals who want to start a career in complex B2B sales, focused on opening new accounts and generating new business in the genomics market.

As a Technical Sales Specialist I, you will be trained to prospect actively, build new pipeline and close your first deals, using NGS knowledge as a competitive advantage in customer conversations.


What you will do

  • Actively prospect new customers through outbound activities, cold calls, emails and networking.
  • Identify, qualify and open new sales opportunities in assigned territories or segments.
  • Build new pipeline aligned with quarterly and annual new business targets.
  • Conduct discovery meetings focused on customer pain points, budget and decision process.
  • Position NGS solutions to win first deals in new accounts.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data, pipeline hygiene and forecasting.
  • Support initial account penetration before handover or expansion.


What we are looking for


  • Background in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, Engineering or similar.
  • Strong hunter mindset with motivation to generate new business.
  • Comfortable working with targets, commissions and outbound activity.
  • Resilience, discipline and high activity level.
  • Clear communication and willingness to learn complex sales.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).

  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).

We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.

  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with strong backend expertise and solid experience in API integrations to join our team. This role will focus on building and maintaining integrations with Shopify Fulfillment Services, designing robust event-driven systems, and ensuring high reliability across distributed components.


If you are passionate about scalable architectures, clean code, and solving complex integration challenges, this opportunity is for you.

  • Build internal system adapters and perform complex data mapping
  • Implement webhook processing and event-driven workflows
  • Design robust error handling, retry strategies, and idempotent processes
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with the team on API design, architecture decisions, and technical improvements
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues with a proactive mindset


✅ Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with Python development
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of webhook architecture and event handling
  • Experience with OAuth authentication flows
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify experience is highly preferred)
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and message queues
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English communication skills

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Analista Atração e Seleção PL (Vaga Afirmativa PCD)
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção apaixonada por diversidade e inclusão, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados. Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para profissionais PCDs que desejam fazer a diferença promovendo um ambiente mais plural e representativo.



Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir processos seletivos de diferentes níveis e áreas (foco em posições operacionais)
  • Atuar com alto volume de vagas simultâneas, garantindo agilidade e qualidade na entrega;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de atração com foco em diversidade;
  • Realizar triagens, entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo;
  • Apoiar na construção de parcerias com consultorias e instituições voltadas à inclusão;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva para todas as pessoas candidatas;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizados os sistemas de recrutamento (ATS);


Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, especialmente em vagas de volume;
  • Conhecimento em entrevistas por competências e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental;
  • Vivência com ações afirmativas e programas de diversidade e inclusão;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de ATS/Plataformas de divulgações;


Benefícios:


  • Plano de Saúde

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno – SRE/Cloud
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suporte Pleno com foco em SRE e Cloud para atuar na sustentação, evolução e confiabilidade de ambientes críticos em nuvem. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)
  • Administrar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e alertas
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes, realizando troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Apoiar na definição, acompanhamento e cumprimento de SLAs
  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões em escala 24x7
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e expor ideias


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD
  • Vivência com práticas e cultura DevOps
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes e situações críticas de forma estruturada


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de suporte SRE e Cloud para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

A Engesoftware está em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Full Stack (Angular) - Sênior para compor o seu time! Essa vaga inclui Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD


Benefícios:

  • Apoio jurídico, caso precise;
  • Apoio nutricional, para uma alimentação mais saudável;
  • Apoio financeiro, para planejar finanças pessoais ou investimento a longo prazo;
  • Apoio social, orientação para momentos pessoais difíceis;
  • Apoio psicológico, para aquecer a mente e o coração;
  • Descontos exclusivos com instituições como Descontos exclusivos com instituições como (SENAI, SESC, Anhanguera, Estácio, IESB, Cruzeiro do Sul, Unifametro e Rockfeller);
  • Plano Enge Pets, para que seu pet tenha o melhor cuidado;
  • Parceria com o Bali Park, um espaço de lazer e entretenimento;
  • VA/VR;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico (Bradesco);
  • Seguro de vida (Santander Zurich);


Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino superior concluído em TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área.
  • Conhecimento com as seguintes tecnologias: Java 21 (concorrência e virtual threads), arquitetura de pipelines de dados, Spring Boot 3.x (microsserviços), Spring Batch, Kafka Streams, Quarkus, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Azure, Sonar (qualidade de código) e logs estruturados com ELK para observabilidade e rastreabilidade.


Estamos em busca de um profissional que queira somar com o nosso time e crescer com a gente! Venha ser um Power Enge!!!

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to . Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies
